title: A new gateway route must be registered in the auth validator map, response filter map, and gateway-disable test together
answers: adding a new gateway endpoint and it is open to all authenticated users
what must change when adding a route under /gateway/mlflow/v1
new gateway route returns 200 when gateway is disabled
where do I register a new gateway API route for auth
body:
Invariant: a gateway route touches several places that must stay in sync. Adding one means the following change together:
1. The route handler in mlflow/server/gateway_api.py (decorated with gateway_router and translate_http_exception).
2. Its import into mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py, and an entry in the validator logic in _get_gateway_validator (for list routes, the authentication-only branch).
3. A response filter in FASTAPI_ENDPOINT_RESPONSE_FILTERS when the response leaks resources the caller may not use.
4. Static-prefix validator assertions in tests/server/auth/test_auth.py:test_find_fastapi_validator_handles_static_prefix, plus the 501 check in tests/server/test_gateway_disable.py:test_gateway_endpoints_return_501_when_disabled.
Breaks if skipped: the route is reachable without the intended check, or it answers when the gateway is disabled.
Applies: any new route under the gateway_router.
applies: New or changed routes on gateway_router in mlflow/server/gateway_api.py.
says: AI gateway endpoints still respond even after the gateway service is turned off

search: Adding a route to gateway_router in mlflow/server/gateway_api.py requires updating the handler, auth validator logic, response filters, and disable tests together. Handlers decorated with gateway_router and translate_http_exception must be registered in _get_gateway_validator in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py and optionally in FASTAPI_ENDPOINT_RESPONSE_FILTERS. Tests in tests/server/auth/test_auth.py:test_find_fastapi_validator_handles_static_prefix and tests/server/test_gateway_disable.py:test_gateway_endpoints_return_501_when_disabled must be updated to prevent unauthenticated access or answering when disabled.
